title: Talk in Pieces, See in Whole: Disentangled and Hierarchical Representation Learning in Language-based Object Detection
abstract: arXiv:2509.24192v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have advanced multimodal perception, demonstrated by open-vocabulary object detection with simple language queries. State-of-the-art VLMs still struggle to handle complex queries involving descriptive attributes and relational clauses. To address this problem, we propose restructuring linguistic representations according to the hierarchical relations within sentences for language-based object detection. A key insight is that textual tokens should be disentangled into core components-objects, attributes, and relations-and aggregated into hierarchically structured sentence-level representations. Building on this principle, we introduce the TaSe (Talk in Pieces, See in Whole) framework with three main contributions: (1) a hierarchical synthetic captioning dataset spanning three tiers from category names to descriptive sentences; (2) the three-component disentanglement module guided by a novel disentan

translated_title: 分而谈之，统而观之：基于语言的目标检测中的解耦与层次化表示学习
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）已经推动了多模态感知的发展，这一点通过使用简单语言查询的开放词汇目标检测得到了证明。然而，最先进的VLMs仍然难以处理涉及描述性属性和关系从句的复杂查询。为了解决这一问题，我们提出根据句子内部的层次关系来重构语言表示，以服务于基于语言的目标检测。一个关键洞察是：文本token应当被解耦为核心组件——对象、属性和关系——并聚合为层次结构化的句子级表示。基于这一原则，我们提出了TaSe（Talk in Pieces, See in Whole，分而谈之、统而观之）框架，包含三个主要贡献：(1) 一个跨越三个层级的层次化合成字幕数据集，从类别名称一直到描述性句子；(2) 由一种新颖的解耦（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出TaSe框架，通过将文本token解耦为对象、属性和关系三个核心组件并聚合为层次化的句子级表示，使视觉-语言模型能够处理包含描述性属性和关系从句的复杂语言查询，从而提升基于语言的目标检测性能。
en_tdlr: The TaSe framework disentangles textual tokens into objects, attributes, and relations, and aggregates them into hierarchical sentence-level representations, enabling vision-language models to handle complex language queries with descriptive attributes and relational clauses for improved language-based object detection.
